# apfsctl v0.2.0-beta.3

This beta adds a one-line installer for published macOS binaries.

- Install the latest published release with `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmeiracorbal/apfsctl/main/install.sh | bash`.
- Pin a release with `APFSCTL_VERSION` or choose an install path with `APFSCTL_INSTALL_DIR`.
- Detect Apple Silicon or Intel and verify the downloaded archive against the published SHA-256 checksums before installation.
- The installer installs only the CLI binary; APFS operations remain explicit commands.

**Beta:** privileged APFS operations and reboot behavior still need validation on physical macOS devices. Use a disposable volume and keep a backup. Encrypted volumes need to be unlocked after restart. Binaries are unsigned and not notarized.
